entries.title: Ezekiel 42:1
segments: ¶Then he brought me forth into the utter court, the way toward the north: and he brought me into the chamber that [was] over against the separate place, and which [was] before the building toward the north.

words.text: that [was] over against the separate place

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:2
segments: Before the length of an hundred cubits [was] the north door, and the breadth [was] fifty cubits.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:3
segments: Over against the twenty [cubits] which [were] for the inner court, and over against the pavement which [was] for the utter court, [was] gallery against gallery in three [stories].

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:4
segments: And before the chambers [was] a walk of ten cubits breadth inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors toward the north.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:5

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:6
segments: For they [were] in three [stories], but had not pillars as the pillars of the courts: therefore [the building] was straitened more than the lowest and the middlemost from the ground.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:7
segments: And the wall that [was] without over against the chambers, toward the utter court on the forepart of the chambers, the length thereof [was] fifty cubits.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:8
segments: For the length of the chambers that [were] in the utter court [was] fifty cubits: and, lo, before the temple [were] an hundred cubits.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:10
segments: The chambers [were] in the thickness of the wall of the court toward the east, over against the separate place, and over against the building.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:11
segments: And the way before them [was] like the appearance of the chambers which [were] toward the north, as long as they, [and] as broad as they: and all their goings out [were] both according to their fashions, and according to their doors.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:12
segments: And according to the doors of the chambers that [were] toward the south [was] a door in the head of the way, [even] the way directly before the wall toward the east, as one entereth into them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:13
segments: Then said he unto me, The north chambers [and] the south chambers, which [are] before the separate place, they [be] holy chambers, where the priests that approach unto the LORD shall eat the most holy things: there shall they lay the most holy things, and the meat offering, and the sin offering, and the trespass offering; for the place [is] holy.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:14
segments: When the priests enter therein, then shall they not go out of the holy [place] into the utter court, but there they shall lay their garments wherein they minister; for they [are] holy; and shall put on other garments, and shall approach to [those things] which [are] for the people.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:15
segments: ¶Now when he had made an end of measuring the inner house, he brought me forth toward the gate whose prospect [is] toward the east, and measured it round about.

entries.title: Ezekiel 42:20
segments: He measured it by the four sides: it had a wall round about, five hundred [reeds] long, and five hundred broad, to make a separation between the sanctuary and the profane place.
